en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1843 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Indeed, the number of months with Allah (swt) is twelve months in the Book of Allah (swt) from the day He created the heavens and the earth.

The first and foremost of these months is the month of Allah (swt), which is the Month of Ramadan, and the heart of the Month of Ramadan is the Night of Qadr. The Quran was revealed on the first night of the Month of Ramadan. Therefore, greet the month with the Quran."
